No le doy más estrellas porque en los surtidores me dijeron que no andaba el sistema de cobro y solo aceptaban efectivo. Y el aire para inflar las ruedas está fuera de servicio.

We used the service bays to have the suspension on our Corsa repaired, and they did a fantastic job. They even gave us a quick appointment.
I'm not giving it more stars because at the gas pumps they told me the payment system wasn't working and they were only accepting cash. And the tire inflator was out of service.
